daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

President Prabowo urged BRIN researchers to focus on advancing energy, food, and aerospace research during a visit where he also tested BRIN-made roof tiles by stepping and stomping on them, demonstrating his desire to replace metal roofing with domestically produced alternatives. Prabowo further pledged major investment in education and research while calling for fact-based governance rather than scapegoating.

  • The KPK is yet to detain two DPR members one year after the BI-OJK CSR funds case emerged.
  • A DPR member urged the government to improve job quality following declining unemployment figures.
  • Commission III of the DPR denied any presidential letter regarding a change in the National Police chief, calling for speculation to end.
  • Finance Minister Purbaya intervened as 79 local governments face difficulties paying employee salaries.
  • The Ministry of Higher Education clarified that the main author of an MBG paper that misused President Prabowo's name is not a lecturer.
  • Legal expert Nasyirul stated that asset seizure provisions in the Asset Forfeiture Bill before trial need constitutional review.
  • The Ministry of Law responded to MUI's call by noting that death penalty for corruptors is already provided for in existing law.

Foreign Policy & Defence

Following a joint military exercise, TNI Commander pledged to safeguard every inch of Indonesian territory. The statement underscored Indonesia's commitment to territorial sovereignty amid ongoing military readiness exercises.

  • Indonesia and seven other Arab-Islamic countries urged Israel to comply with international law.
  • The Foreign Ministry emphasized the importance of cross-cultural religious literacy within ASEAN.
  • Indonesia expanded film cooperation with the Motion Picture Association of America.
  • PT PAL began production of Scorpène Evolved submarines, strengthening Indonesia-France cooperation.
  • The Ministry of Defence will renovate nine LVRI offices and improve 52 veteran homes across 19 provinces.

Other

The Indonesian Medical Council (KKI) is investigating 10 doctors and health workers for posting unempathetic comments mocking BPJS patients, with the number potentially rising as more cases are identified. The scandal has sparked national outrage and led to at least one health worker resigning from RSUD dr Soekardjo Tasikmalaya.

  • BRIN launched the Lampung-1 satellite from China and assured data security for the provincial development project.
  • BRIN said ANG technology could reduce LPG subsidy burdens.
  • President Prabowo ordered protection of citizens from forest and land fires while promising additional budget allocation.
  • Indonesia and South Korea agreed to cooperate on controlling forest and land fires, with the forestry minister noting that smoke knows no borders.
  • Pertamina's Tanjung Sekong LPG terminal became the world's first to receive green terminal certification.
